ruleBlocks.title: Ключевое отличие
lines: Present Perfect = связь с настоящим (результат сейчас / опыт / период не закончен)
Past Simple = конкретное прошлое (есть yesterday/ago/last.../in 2010 и т.п.)
Маркеры PP: already, just, yet, ever/never, for/since, this week/year, so far
Вопрос «когда?» почти всегда тянет Past Simple

items.explain: already ⇒ Present Perfect; see → seen, I → have.

items.prompt: John and Julie ____ ____ their car for about a year. (have)
items.explain: for + период ⇒ длится до сих пор; have/has + had.
yet (в отрицании) ⇒ Present Perfect; take → taken, she → has.

items.prompt: Sue ____ ____ a tour guide since she left university. (be)
items.explain: since + точка отсчёта ⇒ до настоящего; be → been.

items.prompt: ____ you ____ into town on your new bike yet? (ride)
items.explain: вопрос + yet ⇒ Present Perfect; ride → ridden, you → have (Have you…?).

items.prompt: This new computer ____ ____ my life a lot easier. (make)
items.explain: результат «сейчас» (жизнь стала легче) ⇒ Present Perfect; make → made, computer → has.

items.prompt: We ____ ____ what to get Mark for his birthday yet. (not/decide)
items.explain: yet ⇒ «ещё не» до настоящего; decide → decided, we → have.
ever ⇒ опыт «когда-либо» ⇒ Present Perfect; meet → met, Paul → has (Has Paul…?).

items.prompt: Выбери: Present Perfect или Past Simple?
options: I've never played this game before.
I never played this game before.
items.explain: never, before ⇒ опыт до настоящего ⇒ Present Perfect.

options: Adam has tidied his room last night.
Adam tidied his room last night.
items.explain: last night = конкретное прошлое ⇒ Past Simple.
since 2005 ⇒ до настоящего ⇒ Present Perfect.

options: Carol and I have gone to the cinema three nights ago.
Carol and I went to the cinema three nights ago.
items.explain: … ago ⇒ конкретное прошлое ⇒ Past Simple.

options: It's the first time you've visited our flat, isn't it?
It's the first time you visit our flat, isn't it?
items.explain: It’s the first time + Present Perfect (первый раз в жизни до сейчас).

options: They haven't given the baby a name yet.
They didn't give the baby a name yet.
items.explain: yet ⇒ «ещё не» ⇒ Present Perfect.

options: Have you gone to New York when you went to the States last summer?
Did you go to New York when you went to the States last summer?
items.explain: last summer + конкретная поездка в прошлом ⇒ Past Simple.

options: Have you ever sent an e-mail before?
Did you ever send an e-mail before?
items.explain: ever, before ⇒ жизненный опыт ⇒ Present Perfect.

accepted: The lesson has not started yet.
items.explain: yet ⇒ Present Perfect (отрицание).

items.prompt: The teacher / already / write / on the board.
accepted: The teacher has already written on the board.
items.explain: already ⇒ Present Perfect.

items.prompt: Joe and Tim / just / come / into the classroom.
accepted: Joe and Tim have just come into the classroom.
items.explain: just ⇒ «только что» ⇒ Present Perfect.

items.prompt: Tony / not finish / getting his books ready.
accepted: Tony hasn't finished getting his books ready.
Tony has not finished getting his books ready.
items.explain: действие ещё не завершено (результат важен сейчас) ⇒ Present Perfect.

accepted: Christine has already opened her book.
items.explain: already ⇒ Present Perfect.

items.prompt: Dave / drop / a pen on the floor.
accepted: Dave has dropped a pen on the floor.
items.explain: результат сейчас (ручка на полу) ⇒ Present Perfect.

items.prompt: He / not pick it up / yet.
accepted: He hasn't picked it up yet.
He has not picked it up yet.
items.explain: yet ⇒ Present Perfect (отрицание).
